title: Search filters and batch
change_summary: C API and bindings: id allow/deny filters on HNSW or exact scan (up to 4096 ids), search_batch, min_score, get_many, and timestamp cuts on search_filtered. Closes #134, #136, #144.
bindings_note: Python, Node, and C++. On-disk format unchanged. logosdb-mcp-server 1.4.6 depends on logosdb ^1.7.0.
tagline: Embedded vector DB for AI agents and RAG
release_tagline: Filter ids, batch queries, and fetch embeddings in one call

highlights.name: allow / deny
highlights.desc: Search this vector DB inside an id set, or drop ids you have already seen.

highlights.name: search_batch
highlights.desc: Many queries in one call. Each row comes back as ids and scores.

highlights.name: min_score, get_many
highlights.desc: Drop weak hits, then load those embeddings from the vector DB together.

install: pip install logosdb   ·   npm i logosdb
